Overview

Oaxaca is a city in Oaxaca with a population of 270,955. Cultural heart of southern Mexico with indigenous traditions, world-renowned cuisine, and colonial architecture. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
